 The workers agreed to postpone the strike until midnight tonight pending another conference be- tween the Railway Mems Union of the Great Southern Railway, and Irish Omnibus Company.

 Recognition of the Bus Drivers Union is sought. The Railroad Men will strike in sympathy.
